container.echostorage.echo_bundle.catego: With a Category, the bundle picks up what the Category matches. With none, it picks up what it already holds.
container.echostorage.echo_bundle.vacuum: When on, items you pick up go into this bundle first if it wants them. Off until you turn it on.
container.echostorage.echo_chest.categor: Items outside the Category are marked, never moved. Shift-click this button to go back.
When on, shift-click and hoppers refuse items outside the Category. Placing by hand always works.
container.echostorage.echo_chest.quick_s: Puts away everything in your inventory, not your hotbar, that this chest already holds. Bundles inside that hold an item are topped up first. Shift-click only fills slots and never fills a bundle.
